address: 13F, The Peninsula Hotel, Bund 32, 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Named after the hotel's founder, the opulent space punctuated by red accents commands gorgeous river views. The upscale ambiance makes this a perfect venue for a date. The kitchen turns local ingredients into original creations with bold flavours, dramatic plating and modern Asian twists. The substantial wine list will keep any oenophile happy. If you're not quite ready to call it a night, consider heading to the rooftop bar for digestifs....
